_why: TASK-703 (REQ-115). The list is the new clicked/source test file + plan-tick.test.ts (which pins the create-mode preview row). Written with the set, so nothing here is reconstructed.

mutations.what: 🔴 the badge is read from the STATUS instead of the marker — a CONFIRMED make-up loses it, which is the exact defect REQ-115 exists to prevent
🔴 the badge REPLACES the status instead of joining it — a make-up stops showing that it is CONFIRMED
🔴 the create-mode preview's make-up row is NOT marked — the preview differs from what the server creates
⚠️ a LEGACY EXTENDED make-up is badged TWICE (its status chip and the added badge)
🔴 the mapper drops the marker — every make-up read from the server loses its badge before any screen sees it
⚠️ an ORDINARY class gets the badge too (the marker is ignored, the badge is added to every non-EXTENDED row)
